status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
principle: preserve each JRA ticket market distribution and only tilt it by the horse-level model-vs-win-market log probability edge

ticketMarketProbability.win: normalized inverse JRA win odds, mass 1
ticketMarketProbability.quinella: normalized inverse JRA quinella odds, mass 1
ticketMarketProbability.wide: normalized inverse JRA wide lower-bound odds, mass 3

renormalization: renormalize each ticket pool back to its original race mass before scoring
ticketScore: tilted ticket probability * corresponding JRA official odds; wide uses official lower bound

expertChoice.afterColdStart: highest Bayesian-shrunk decayed top-ticket return using dates strictly before current race date

raceSelection.selector: expanding LightGBM Huber regression of realized fixed-portfolio race return using prior dates only
raceSelection.coldStart: mean top-3 ticket score across required types

allocation: mandatory 100 yen to the top ticket of each required type, then allocate remaining units by ticket score multiplied by prior-date Bayesian type/expert return, respecting 10% per-ticket cap
